content.scenario: A consumer, Priya, takes a loan from a bank, ABC Bank, with a condition that she cannot repay the loan before the end of the loan period without paying a penalty. However, Priya wants to repay the loan early and is willing to pay the applicable penalty.
content.outcome: ABC Bank must accept the early repayment of the debt from Priya as refusing to do so would be an unfair contract term.

user_queries: Can a consumer repay a debt early?
What are the conditions for early repayment of a debt?
Is refusing early repayment an unfair contract term?
